versions.changelog: Major update: Pivoted to AI Planning Coach. Now live on Telegram (@fourtooneplannerbot). Correct 4to1 Method hierarchy: 4 Years → 3 Months → 2 Weeks → 1 Day. All templates free. Supports Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar, local Markdown.

Initial release of 4to1-planner: an AI planning coach using the 4To1 Method™.

- Guides users to turn a 4-year vision into daily action using a 4-layer system.
- Supports Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar, or local Markdown for backend storage.
- Offers guided onboarding to set up vision, goals, and planning workflows.
- Includes explicit support for Not-To-Do Projects and Time Wasters elimination.
- User-invocable with simple planning-related prompts.
